mapper.update: UPDATE approval_request a JOIN remediation_action ra ON ra.id = a.remediation_action_id JOIN remediation_plan p ON p.id = ra.remediation_plan_id SET a.status = 'CANCELLED', a.decided_by = #{actor}, a.decided_at = #{at}, a.updated_at = #{at}, a.lock_version = a.lock_version + 1 WHERE p.incident_id = #{incidentId} AND a.status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_request a JOIN remediation_action ra ON ra.id = a.remediation_action_id JOIN remediation_plan p ON p.id = ra.remediation_plan_id WHERE p.incident_id = #{incidentId} AND a.status = 'PENDING')
